#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fuzz: random requests must never crash, and accepted wires must be stable."""
import json, random, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {
        "sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
        "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"],
        "sip:x@y.test": [],
    },
    "accounts": {
        "s1": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": ["sip:desk@sales.test"]},
        "s2": {"primary": "sip:desk@sales.test", "allow": ["sip:ember@studio.test", "sip:x@y.test"]},
    },
    "gateways": {
        "g": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test", "y.test"],
              "peers": {"p": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "q": ["y.test"]}},
        "h": {"local_domains": ["studio.test"], "peers": {"p": ["sales.test"]}},
    },
}
LOCAL = lambda: {"kind": "local", "subject": random.choice(["s1", "s2", "zz"])}
PEER = lambda: {"kind": "peer", "name": random.choice(["p", "q", "r"])}
UNTR = {"kind": "untrusted"}
URIPOOL = ["sip:ember@studio.test", "sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121",
           "sip:desk@sales.test", "tel:+12025550122", "sip:x@y.test",
           "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid", "sip:zz@y.test", "tel:+111",
           "SIP:Ember@STUDIO.TEST.", "sip:%65mber@studio.test", "sip:ember@studio.test.",
           "sip:ember@studio.test:5060", "sip:ember@no.host", "sips:ember@studio.test",
           "tel:+0123", "tel:123", "sip:@studio.test"]
FRAGS = ["From", "To", "Call-ID", "CSeq", "Content-Length", "Content-Type", "Privacy",
         "P-Preferred-Identity", "Remote-Party-ID", "P-Asserted-Identity", "f", "t", "i",
         "l", "c", "X-Other", "Via", "Contact", "Authorization"]
VALS = ["<%s>", "< %s >", "%s", '"D, x" <%s>', "Bob <%s>", "Bob\t<%s>", '"Un <%s>;"<%s>',
        "<%s>;tag=ab", "<%s> ; tag = ab", "<%s>;tag=", "<%s>;other=1", "<%s>,<%s>",
        "<%s>, <%s>", '"", <%s>', "<%s>,", ",<%s>", "<>", "<%s> extra", "<%s><%s>"]
BODIES = ["", "hello", "a\r\nb", "\r\n", "x" * 50, "From: <sip:evil@bad.test>\r\n\r\n",
          "a\rb", "a\nb", "a\tb"]

def rand_request(rng):
    hs = []
    n = rng.randint(0, 8)
    for _ in range(n):
        name = rng.choice(FRAGS)
        v = rng.choice(VALS)
        while "%s" in v:
            v = v.replace("%s", rng.choice(URIPOOL), 1)
        hs.append("%s: %s" % (name, v))
    body = rng.choice(BODIES)
    hs += ["From: " + rng.choice(VALS) % () if False else "From: " + (rng.choice(VALS) % (rng.choice(URIPOOL),) if "%s" in rng.choice(VALS) else rng.choice(URIPOOL)),
           "To: " + rng.choice(URIPOOL), "Call-ID: " + rng.choice(["c", "c-1", "x" * 130, "a b"]),
           "CSeq: " + rng.choice(["9 MESSAGE", "0 MESSAGE", "9 INVITE", "9MESSAGE", "2147483648 MESSAGE"])]
    rng.shuffle(hs)
    text = "MESSAGE %s SIP/2.0\r\n" % rng.choice(URIPOOL)
    text += "".join(h + "\r\n" for h in hs)
    text += "Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n%s" % (len(body), body)
    if rng.random() < 0.15:
        text = text.replace("\r\n", "\n")
    if rng.random() < 0.05:
        text += "\r\n"
    return text

def run(jobs):
    batch = dict(CTX); batch["jobs"] = jobs
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    assert proc.returncode == 0, (proc.returncode, proc.stderr[-3000:])
    return json.loads(proc.stdout)["results"]

rng = random.Random(20240115)
problems = 0
for round_ in range(60):
    jobs = []
    for _ in range(60):
        kind = rng.choice(["local", "peer", "untrusted"])
        ing = LOCAL() if kind == "local" else (PEER() if kind == "peer" else UNTR)
        jobs.append({"gateway": rng.choice(["g", "h"]),
                     "ingress": ing,
                     "trusted_out": rng.random() < 0.5,
                     "raw": rand_request(rng)})
    res = run(jobs)
    assert len(res) == len(jobs)
    # invariant: accepted wire reprocessed with the same ingress yields the same identity+wire
    for job, r in zip(jobs, res):
        if r["status"] != "accept":
            continue
        r2 = run([dict(job, raw=r["wire"])])[0]
        if r2["status"] != "accept" or r2["identity"] != r["identity"] or r2["wire"] != r["wire"]:
            problems += 1
            print("UNSTABLE", json.dumps(job), "\n  1:", json.dumps(r), "\n  2:", json.dumps(r2))
            if problems > 3:
                sys.exit(1)
print("fuzz done, problems =", problems)
PYEOF
cd /workspace && timeout 600 python3 tmp/fuzz.py
